verdict.rationale: The desktop coding agent can review pull requests via `gh` (omnirush-gui-gh-5), so PR review is possible. That review happens on demand inside a user-driven chat session, with no evidence of automatic triggering on every PR. Missing for 10: automatic per-PR review triggering (CI/webhook/GitHub app integration), documentation of contextual inline feedback/comments, independent or hands-on corroboration of review quality.
